audience: Contoso executive sponsors: COO, CIO and the Consulting practice lead. Business-minded, not deeply technical.
objective: Win approval for a 2-week, 10-user pilot of Surface Laptop Ultra with NVIDIA RTX Spark running local AI for traveling consultants, alongside Microsoft 365 Copilot.
context: Contoso is a fictional professional-services firm. Its consultants travel to client sites, where guest Wi-Fi is often restricted and client documents are sensitive. They spend a lot of time turning interview notes and site documents into client summaries. Contoso already uses Microsoft 365 Copilot and will keep it; the pitch is to add a local AI lane on the device for sensitive, repeated drafting work, not to replace anything.
facts: Each consultant writes about 6 client summaries per week.
A client summary takes about 25 minutes to draft today.
About 30% of client sites restrict guest Wi-Fi.

Illustrative capacity: if a local assistant saved 5 minutes per summary, 1,200 consultants x 6 summaries x 5 minutes x 46 working weeks = 27,600 hours per year. Unvalidated; the pilot measures the real number.
Device: Surface Laptop Ultra with NVIDIA RTX Spark (Blackwell RTX GPU, 20 CPU cores, 128 GB installed memory).
On this device, Gemma 4 26B decodes at about 72 tokens per second and Qwen3-Coder 30B at about 86 tokens per second (single stream, Local-AI-Bench, October 2026).
28 open models are installed in the local catalog on this device.
Microsoft 365 Copilot stays in place; local AI adds a second lane (hybrid).
Pilot: 10 users for 2 weeks (14 days), measuring task time, draft quality and user experience.
This deck was generated on this Surface Laptop Ultra by a local model, with no cloud calls.
guardrails: Do not claim dollar savings, ROI or license savings.
Do not claim local AI replaces Microsoft 365 Copilot or any subscription.
Do not claim air-gapped, certified offline or security certification; say disconnected use is validated in the pilot.
Do not cite TOPS or Copilot+ PC certification.
The 27,600 hours figure is illustrative and must be labeled as an estimate to validate.
